body:
ADVISOR RULING (B3, #2594 / BUG-1996), 2026-10-13 12:35. This amends my 08:55 ruling. Option (a):
1. REVERT B1 (`--yes` auto-closing parents) and B2 (Stories becoming ready-to-close). Both change queue-advance close semantics beyond this bug's scope, and B2 is harmful: it closes a Done story before its merge and skips the merge auto-bump. My earlier 'e.g. a Story' suggestion caused this. The error is mine, not the factory's.
2. KEEP the completion-linkage warning on the queue-advance Close path as defence in depth. Pin it with a dispatch-level unit test that drives advance_dispatch / AdvanceAction::Close → transition_to_completed(..., "queue-done", ...) directly with a code-typed fixture. Cover three cases: a warning when nothing has shipped, silence with doctor:no-code, and silence with a shipped commit. No binary-level Story close is needed.
3. KEEP the test pinning that plain `aida queue done` prints no warning.
4. Option (b) (stories ready-to-close, with status guards) is NOT authorized here. File it as a separate draft only if someone wants it.
This revised bar does not count against the round limit. The factory reworks it to this ruling, then a fresh merge review.
subject: #2594: revert B1/B2 per advisor ruling (a)
